$doc: Era layout spec v2 — DATA, NOT CODE (roadmap/plans/foil-main.md).
MEASURED IN CANONICAL SPACE (4b, 2026-09-01). Rects are fractions of the
card FACE, origin TOP-LEFT (matches image space; the shader converts to UV
y-up). A fraction is invariant under a uniform scale, so it names a place
on the physical card and not a place in some raster — which is the whole
reason the cutover from the old 600x825 provenance line costs nothing here.
cardAspect and cornerRadius are DERIVED from packages/core/src/card-space.json
(63 x 88 mm, 3 mm corner, 8 px/mm -> 504 x 704). They are written out here
because this file is read as data by both apps, but they are not free
numbers: packages/forge/src/__tests__/canonical-space.test.ts recomputes both
from the millimetre constants and fails if either drifts. cardAspect was
[245, 337] until 4b — TCGdex's small-size raster, 1.55% short of the card.
cornerRadius was 0.047, a rounded 3/63.
artWindow = the illustration box inside the frame. holoZone semantics:
window = foil fills the art window (classic holo rares),
sheet  = foil fills everything EXCEPT the art window (reverse holo),
full   = foil covers the whole face (full-art / etched / ex rarities).
WHY NO RECT MOVED IN THE CUTOVER. 4a measured, per (host, quality, era),
the bounding box of the printed card inside each framing. Every era whose
rects were fitted here (wotc, modern-sv, modern-swsh) sits on framings that
are either pure resamples — margins 0 px on every sample, so a fractional
rect carries over untouched — or, for wotc/dp/ecard/ex/sm, PER-CARD
VARIABLE: margins that differ card to card (wotc 600x825 medians 5/17.5/
7.5/17.5 px L/T/R/B at sd ~10). A per-card-variable framing has no single
offset to refit by. The MEDIAN transform is recorded in data/frames.json
with its spread beside it, which is the honest state; refitting these rects
by an average margin would swap a stated uncertainty for a hidden one. The
fine correction is a hand mask — which is exactly why vintage hand-masks
earn the most in 3a's leverage ranking.
This file is the layout-driven coarse mask tier only; art-driven masks
are a later foil/masks sub-branch (see .claude/skills/mask-pipeline).

wotc.label: WOTC 1999–2003 (Base–Skyridge)
wotc.notes: Gold-bevel art box below the name bar. WOTC holo `window` scope = art-window rect MINUS the subject silhouette — the Starlight sheet sits behind the illustration background only (codified observation, n=1: data/foil-masks/codified/wotc.md; not expressible as a rect — tier-2 work item, uArtGate approximates it meanwhile). No reverse holos before Legendary Collection.

modern-swsh.label: Sword & Shield 2020–2022
modern-swsh.measuredOn: approximation — borrows modern-sv rects; re-measure when SWSH work starts
modern-swsh.notes: Frame proportions close enough to SV for the coarse tier; SWSH reverse sheet uses vertical bar texture (different pattern, same sheet zone).

modern-sv.label: Scarlet & Violet 2023– (incl. Mega Evolution 2025–)
modern-sv.measuredOn: me04-007 (Chesnaught) 600x825; top edge re-measured 2026-08-08 on six me05 scans (true printed edge y=65px/674, was 106px)
modern-sv.notes: Silver-border frame; art box runs from below the name bar to the species strip. Holo rares foil the art window; SV reverse sheet carries Poke Ball stamp texture over the body; ex / Illustration rare / Special illustration rare / Hyper rare are full-face foil.
